English

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Dharug gula or gulawany.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • enPR: kō-ä'lə, IPA(key): /koʊˈɑː.lə/, /kəʊˈɑː.lə/, /ˈkwɑː.lə/
  • (General Australian) IPA(key): /kəˈwɑː.lə/, /kəʊˈɑː.lə/
  • Audio (Southern England):(file)
  • Audio (US):(file)
  • Audio (General Australian):(file)
  • Rhymes: -ɑːlə

Noun

[edit]

koala (plural koalas)

  2. A tree-dwelling marsupial, Phascolarctos cinereus, that resembles a small bear with a broad head, large ears and sharp claws, mainly found in eastern Australia.
    Synonyms: Phascolarctos cinereus, koala bear, (obsolete) native bear, (obsolete) native monkey, carbora

Derived terms

[edit]
  • koala fucker
  • koala lemur

Related terms

[edit]
  • drop bear
